headline: How Long Does It Take for Nail Growth?
content: Each individual has their own nail growth rate but generally nails grow about 1 millimeter per week. Made up of keratin protein, fingernails take approximately a year to reach full length while toenails may require between one to eighteen months depending on various factors like health conditions.
